item.title: HIGHLIGHTS: Alabama rallies to take down Florida State; QB Keelon Russell shines with 406 total yds.
item.author: Alabama Crimson Tide on AL.com
item.description:
HIGHLIGHTS: Despite the lightning delays, Alabama rallied from down 21-6 to take down Florida State.
QB Keelon Russell threw for 320 yards and 3 touchdowns along with running for 86 and a score in a wild one. 🐘🏈 #rolltide
